assumptions.source: Synthetic assumptions, not observed bakery transactions
assumptions.scope: One hypothetical bakery and one product; dates are simulated
assumptions.openingStock: 120 units with seeded integer variation from -15 to +15
assumptions.dailyDemand: Seeded multiplier between 0.85 and 1.15, rounded to three decimals
assumptions.hourlyVariation: Seeded integer variation from -2 to +2 units before demand is rounded
assumptions.stockRule: Sales are capped by available stock; remaining stock carries forward without replenishment
assumptions.intervention: Regular-price sales only; no rescue discounts, reservations or pickup outcomes
assumptions.limits: More generated rows do not establish forecast accuracy or represent real customer demand
